description: Remembered download destinations, persistent queues and file-verified history, plus AI video discovery with configured providers and a searchable result archive.

tools.name: inspect_video
tools.description: Set an optional video URL in the panel and use local yt-dlp to inspect its metadata. Call this when the user supplies a URL or the panel has not inspected its current URL yet.

url.description: Optional complete http or https video URL. Omit it to inspect the URL already shown in the panel.

playlist.description: Optional inspection mode. True inspects playlist entries; false inspects only the current video.

tools.name: get_video_download_context
tools.description: Read the current URL, inspection and download status, concurrent download queue, concurrency limit and pause state, inspected video metadata, destination, available local dependencies, and download configuration.

tools.name: refresh_video_download_dependencies
tools.description: Re-check whether yt-dlp and ffmpeg are visible to the running Mimi Download panel after initialization or repair. This never installs software or downloads media.

tools.name: apply_video_download_config
tools.description: Set the quality, optional playlist range, and subtitle source/language/embed settings in the Mimi Download panel. This never starts the download and never selects a Cookie account.

playlistItems.description: Optional yt-dlp playlist selection such as 1-5,8,10-12. Use an empty string to clear it.

playlistEnd.description: Optional maximum playlist item number. Use 0 to clear it. Ignored when playlistItems is set.

subtitleMode.description: Choose human-provided subtitles, automatic subtitles, or both.

subtitleLanguages.description: Optional yt-dlp subtitle language expression such as zh-Hans,zh-Hant,en.*.

embedSubtitles.description: True embeds subtitles into the video when ffmpeg is available; false keeps separate subtitle files.

tools.name: start_video_download
tools.description: Add the current video URL to the bounded concurrent download queue with a snapshot of the configuration, selected Cookie authorization, and destination shown in the panel. The queue starts automatically unless paused. Invoke only when the user explicitly asks to download; configuration alone must never call this tool.

tools.name: cancel_video_download
tools.description: Cancel one running download. Pass queueId from get_video_download_context to target a task; otherwise cancels the selected running task or the first running task.

queueId.description: Optional queue item ID to cancel.

tools.name: find_videos
tools.description: Start an asynchronous AI-assisted search for real public YouTube and Bilibili video results in the panel. An existing configured text-model Provider may be selected. This never downloads media. Call get_video_search_results later to see progress and verified results.

query.description: What kind of videos to find, including any desired topic or filters.

providerId.description: Optional Provider ID from a configured CodeShell model connection.

modelId.description: Optional model connection ID. Takes priority over providerId.

tools.name: get_video_search_results
tools.description: Read the current AI video-search status and up to eight verified platform results from the panel. Search starts separately with find_videos.

tools.name: list_video_search_history
tools.description: Read saved AI video-search queries and their retained YouTube or Bilibili results for the current project.

tools.name: delete_video_search_record
tools.description: Delete one saved AI video-search record from the current project's panel archive. This does not delete downloaded files.
